name: file_ops
description: File operations that are not reading or editing text: move, copy, delete, mkdir, stat, append and hash (sha256 of the contents). Pass op plus path, and to for move and copy, or content for append. Use edit_file to change what is inside a file and read_file to look at it; use this when the file itself has to move, go away, or be measured. move and copy refuse a destination that already exists unless overwrite is set, and delete removes files rather than directories.

op.description: What to do with the path.

path.description: The file or directory to act on, relative to the sandbox root.

to.description: Destination path, for move and copy.

overwrite.description: For move and copy, replace the destination if it already exists. Without it an existing destination is refused.
